title: Handling Missing Data with IS NULL and IS NOT NULL
realWorldScenario: Finance accounts receivable needs to audit unpaid invoices requiring payment collection.
questionStatement: Write a query from the `invoices` table to retrieve `id`, `organization_id`, `amount`, and `status` for all invoices where `paid_at IS NULL`, ordered by `amount` descending.
starterCode:
-- Find unpaid invoices
SELECT id, organization_id, amount, status
FROM invoices
WHERE paid_at IS NULL
ORDER BY amount DESC;
hints: Never use = NULL in SQL; always use IS NULL or IS NOT NULL.

testCases.description: Verify invoices with missing payment date
